purpose: Instructions for organizing DSA problems in the GitHub repository.

rules: Never discard an existing provided solution.
If multiple provided solutions exist, preserve all meaningful variants.
If the existing solution is not optimal, keep it and document the optimal solution separately.
The canonical solution.py should match the canonical/final approach documented in README.md.

approach_rules: Include Brute, Better, and Optimal when meaningful.
If a provided solution exists, include that approach explicitly.
If other useful standard solutions exist, include them too.
Include complexity for each meaningful approach.
readme_md.detail_level: Keep GitHub README concise and revision-friendly. Detailed dry runs belong primarily in Notion.

workflow: Read the existing repository problem files.
Add direct Notion URL to README.md.
